strategy_rationale: Named Microsoft-backed data center project (Project Nova) on specific 244-acre site in Caledonia, WI, though now contested by community opposition.
relevance_rationale: Wisconsin is a Lightpath expansion market and the project is pinned to a specific named village.

dc_mentions.evidence_quote: a sprawling data center on a 244-acre plot of land, big enough to fill 180 football fields. Neither Balch nor his neighbor knew it then, but the proposal, codenamed Project Nova, was backed by Microsoft.
